items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company for Codex and Git tooling
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將收購 Pierre Computer Company，強化 Codex 與 Git 工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., maker of Code Storage and open-source tools including Trees and Diffs already used in Codex. The deal aims to evolve Git workflows for parallel agentic coding, with open-source projects remaining open and Code Storage continuing for customers while features move into Codex. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布將收購 Pierre Computer Company，該公司開發 Code Storage 以及已用於 Codex 的開源工具 Trees 與 Diffs。交易旨在為平行代理編碼演進 Git 工作流程，開源專案將維持開源，Code Storage 在功能整合進 Codex 前仍可供客戶使用。交易需經監管批准後完成。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands OpenAI’s control over the developer stack around Codex as agentic coding scales, potentially setting standards for source control that blend human decisions with agent parallelism. Uncertainty remains around regulatory timing and how deeply the tooling integrates versus competing with GitHub.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉擴大 OpenAI 對 Codex 周邊開發者堆疊的控制，隨著代理編碼規模擴大，可能為結合人類決策與代理平行的版本控制樹立標準。監管時程以及工具整合深度（相對於與 GitHub 競爭）仍存在不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. ... We’re excited to work with the Pierre team to build on the Git workflows that developers already rely on and adapt them to how teams work with coding agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 OpenAI 將收購 Pierre Computer Company, Inc.。…我們期待與 Pierre 團隊合作，在開發者已依賴的 Git 工作流程上進一步發展，並將其調整為適合團隊與編碼代理協作的方式。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI autonomous pipeline finds and patches 948 Linux kernel LPE vulnerabilities
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 自主管線發現並修補 948 個 Linux 內核 LPE 漏洞
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI detailed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, validation, and patching pipeline using an upcoming cyber model that identified 2,308 candidates in the Linux kernel, dynamically reproduced 1,724, and generated 948 working local privilege escalation exploits, at a reported API cost of about $1.2 million. Human researchers reviewed outputs for reporting and patches.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 詳述一套使用即將推出的網路模型的自主漏洞發現、驗證與修補管線，在 Linux 內核中識別 2,308 個候選項目，動態重現 1,724 個，並產生 948 個可用的本地權限提升漏洞利用，報告的 API 成本約 120 萬美元。人類研究人員審查輸出以進行報告與修補。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows frontier cyber models can systematically surface and exploit latent kernel bugs at scale far beyond manual efforts, raising both defensive capability and the urgency of automated patching. Real-world impact depends on how quickly maintainers adopt the patches and whether similar pipelines proliferate to other critical codebases.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿網路模型能系統性地大規模揭露並利用潛在內核漏洞，遠超手動努力，同時提升防禦能力與自動化修補的迫切性。實際影響取決於維護者採用修補的速度，以及類似管線是否擴散至其他關鍵程式碼庫。
items_flat.quote: We've developed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline. In one run with our cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux at an API cost of $1.2 million.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們開發了一套自主的漏洞發現、利用與修補管線。在一次使用我們網路模型的運行中，它驗證並為 Linux 中的 948 個本地權限提升漏洞產生修補，API 成本為 120 萬美元。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with GIF creation and 50% faster generation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Images 2.6，支援 GIF 創作且生成速度提升 50%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, adding GIF generation from prompts or images, saved reference images for consistency, and new API models GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst that generate images 50% faster. Flare can produce images in as little as six seconds at low quality; Sunburst emphasizes higher consistency at medium or high quality. It is available globally across all tiers today.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT、Codex 與 API 中推出 Images 2.6，新增從提示詞或圖像生成 GIF、保存參考圖像以保持一致性，以及新 API 模型 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare 與 Sunburst，生成速度提升 50%。Flare 在低品質設定下最快 6 秒生成圖像；Sunburst 強調中高品質下更高的一致性。今日已全球於所有訂閱層級提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Faster iteration plus native GIFs and reference consistency lowers the barrier for professional and social creative workflows inside ChatGPT and developer tools. Adoption will depend on whether the quality and control gains outweigh token costs and whether competing image models close the speed gap.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更快迭代加上原生 GIF 與參考一致性，降低 ChatGPT 與開發者工具內專業與社群創作工作流程的門檻。採用程度將取決於品質與控制增益是否超過代幣成本，以及競爭圖像模型是否縮小速度差距。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, bringing your ideas to life faster. With this, you can bring motion to your images with GIFs... Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster than before.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在 ChatGPT、Codex 與 API 中推出 Images 2.6，讓你的想法更快實現。透過此功能，你可以用 GIF 為圖像帶來動態…Images 2.6 生成圖像的速度比以往快 50%。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference of model outputs
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 開源 FlashProve，用於可證明的模型輸出推斷
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released FlashProve, an open-source (Apache 2.0) prototype using zkSNARKs so developers can verify a response came from a specific model without revealing weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B MoE, 4-bit), a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/second with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024-token request. It remains a research prototype with no current deployment plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 前沿紅隊釋出 FlashProve，這是使用 zkSNARKs 的開源（Apache 2.0）原型，讓開發者能驗證回應來自特定模型而不揭露權重。在 Llama 4 Maverick（400B MoE、4-bit）上，單一 H100 以約 110 tokens/秒產生證明，每 1,024 token 請求的證明約 19 MB。目前仍為研究原型，尚無部署計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances practical cryptographic verification of model identity, addressing trust issues in routing, evaluation, and potential substitution. It remains a research prototype with substantial overhead relative to inference itself, so production adoption is uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉推進模型身份的實用密碼學驗證，解決路由、評估與潛在替換的信任問題。相對於推斷本身仍有顯著開銷，且為研究原型，生產採用仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: In this post, we share some of that progress, primarily through a system we call FlashProve.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在這篇文章中，我們分享部分進展，主要透過我們稱為 FlashProve 的系統。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出 1 兆參數 Large 4 開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in European data centers, it supports 1M context and ranks highly among open models on coding agent benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 在 Hugging Face 以修改版 MIT 授權釋出 Mistral Large 4（暱稱 Le Chonk）開源權重，這是原生多模態 MoE 模型，總參數約 1 兆、活躍約 490-520 億。在歐洲資料中心以 3,800 顆 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU 訓練，支援 100 萬上下文，並在編碼代理基準中名列開源模型前茅。
items_flat.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference cost and whether the modified license restricts commercial hosting enough to limit distribution.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉強化美國封閉實驗室以外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於推斷成本，以及修改授權是否足以限制商業託管而影響分發。

items_flat.title_en: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor for parallel agent orchestration
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 收購 AI 編碼新創 Conductor，強化平行代理編排
items_flat.summary_en: Meta acquired Conductor, a startup whose platform lets developers run multiple AI coding agents (from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in parallel isolated workspaces. Founder Charlie Holtz confirmed the deal on X and said the team will work with Nat Friedman and Alexandr Wang at Meta Superintelligence Labs; Conductor Cloud will shut down on November 20. Financial terms were not disclosed; Meta confirmed the acquisition to press.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 收購 Conductor，該新創平台讓開發者在平行隔離工作空間中運行多個 AI 編碼代理（來自 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）。創辦人 Charlie Holtz 在 X 確認交易，並表示團隊將與 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的 Nat Friedman 與 Alexandr Wang 合作；Conductor Cloud 將於 11 月 20 日關閉。財務條件未揭露；Meta 向媒體確認收購。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal places Meta in the same race as OpenAI to own developer orchestration tools as coding agents proliferate, potentially accelerating its Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs efforts. Impact is uncertain without disclosed terms or details on product integration, and the rapid cloud shutdown creates a short transition for existing users.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易讓 Meta 與 OpenAI 同場競逐開發者編排工具，隨著編碼代理普及，可能加速其 Muse Code 與 Superintelligence Labs 努力。在未揭露條件或產品整合細節前影響不確定，且雲端服務快速關閉為現有用戶帶來短暫過渡期。
items_flat.quote: I am very excited to share that Conductor is joining Meta! We have some big, crazy plans for the next interface.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我非常興奮地分享 Conductor 即將加入 Meta！我們對下一代介面有一些很大、很瘋狂的計畫。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 使用 Claude 繪製首個原核生物 vault 粒子 3D 結構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s biology research team reported the first cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (L05), showing prokaryotic and phage MVP homologs can form vaults. Claude assisted literature search, isolation optimization, and structure mapping; a preprint has been submitted.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 生物學研究團隊報告由噬菌體蛋白（L05）組裝的 vault 樣粒子首個冷凍電鏡結構，顯示原核生物與噬菌體 MVP 同源物可形成 vault。Claude 協助文獻搜尋、分離優化與結構繪製；預印本已提交。
items_flat.analysis_en: This demonstrates AI accelerating a long-standing open problem in cell biology by compressing multi-week structural work into days under human direction, while still requiring expert validation. Broader scientific impact depends on peer review and whether similar workflows scale to other unsolved molecular structures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此例顯示 AI 在人類指導下將數週結構工作壓縮至數日，加速細胞生物學長期未解問題，但仍需專家驗證。更廣科學影響取決於同儕審查，以及類似工作流程能否擴展至其他未解分子結構。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享 Anthropic 生物學研究實驗室的另一項發現：在原核細胞中發現的 vault 粒子首個 3D 結構。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber) available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak Red（GPT-5.6 Cyber）現已於 AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 Cyber via Daybreak Red is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock. It supports authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing with fewer restrictions than general models.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布透過 Daybreak Red 的 GPT-5.6 Cyber 現已透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供給 AWS GovCloud（US-East）核准客戶。它支援授權的漏洞研究、漏洞利用驗證與安全測試，限制少於一般模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends specialized cyber capabilities into government-grade cloud environments, lowering barriers for public-sector defenders. Broader availability and real-world impact will depend on approval processes and how effectively it integrates with existing security workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將專門的網路能力延伸至政府級雲端環境，降低公共部門防禦者的門檻。更廣可用性與實際影響將取決於核准流程，以及與現有安全工作流程的整合效果。
items_flat.quote: Building on the availability of Daybreak models on Amazon Bedrock, GPT‑5.6 Cyber is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Daybreak Red.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在Daybreak模型於Amazon Bedrock提供的基礎上，GPT‑5.6 Cyber現已透過Daybreak Red向核准客戶在AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Jill Hazelbaker 為首席企業事務官
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber (with prior roles at Snap and Google), as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning. She will report to the CEO.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命前 Uber 總裁兼首席企業事務官 Jill Hazelbaker（曾於 Snap 與 Google 任職）為首席企業事務官，領導全球溝通與企業定位。她將向執行長報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The hire signals OpenAI’s increased investment in external relations and reputation management as it scales. Effectiveness will depend on how the role navigates ongoing regulatory, safety, and competitive pressures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示 OpenAI 在規模擴大時增加對外部關係與聲譽管理的投資。成效將取決於該角色如何應對持續的監管、安全與競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.
items_flat.quote_zh: Jill Hazelbaker將加入OpenAI擔任首席企業事務長，領導公司的全球通訊與企業定位。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind adds agentic cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 為 Antigravity 加入代理化學資訊技能以加速藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched molecular pair analysis, and proposed novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in about an hour.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 為 Google Antigravity 釋出化學資訊技能，結合語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、執行配對分子對分析，並在約一小時內提出帶合成路徑的新型剛性大環化合物。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader utility will depend on accuracy of proposed routes and integration into real laboratory workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委派給專門工具、模型負責規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學循環壓縮至數小時。更廣實用性將取決於所提路徑的準確性，以及與真實實驗室工作流程的整合。
items_flat.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示配備新化學資訊技能的 Google Antigravity 如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

openai.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber) available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
openai.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak Red（GPT-5.6 Cyber）現已於 AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 Cyber via Daybreak Red is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock. It supports authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing with fewer restrictions than general models.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布透過 Daybreak Red 的 GPT-5.6 Cyber 現已透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供給 AWS GovCloud（US-East）核准客戶。它支援授權的漏洞研究、漏洞利用驗證與安全測試，限制少於一般模型。
openai.analysis_en: This extends specialized cyber capabilities into government-grade cloud environments, lowering barriers for public-sector defenders. Broader availability and real-world impact will depend on approval processes and how effectively it integrates with existing security workflows.
openai.analysis_zh: 此舉將專門的網路能力延伸至政府級雲端環境，降低公共部門防禦者的門檻。更廣可用性與實際影響將取決於核准流程，以及與現有安全工作流程的整合效果。
openai.quote: Building on the availability of Daybreak models on Amazon Bedrock, GPT‑5.6 Cyber is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Daybreak Red.
openai.quote_zh: 在Daybreak模型於Amazon Bedrock提供的基礎上，GPT‑5.6 Cyber現已透過Daybreak Red向核准客戶在AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供。

openai.title_en: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Jill Hazelbaker 為首席企業事務官
openai.summary_en: OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber (with prior roles at Snap and Google), as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning. She will report to the CEO.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命前 Uber 總裁兼首席企業事務官 Jill Hazelbaker（曾於 Snap 與 Google 任職）為首席企業事務官，領導全球溝通與企業定位。她將向執行長報告。
openai.analysis_en: The hire signals OpenAI’s increased investment in external relations and reputation management as it scales. Effectiveness will depend on how the role navigates ongoing regulatory, safety, and competitive pressures.
openai.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示 OpenAI 在規模擴大時增加對外部關係與聲譽管理的投資。成效將取決於該角色如何應對持續的監管、安全與競爭壓力。
openai.quote: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.
openai.quote_zh: Jill Hazelbaker將加入OpenAI擔任首席企業事務長，領導公司的全球通訊與企業定位。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference of model outputs
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 開源 FlashProve，用於可證明的模型輸出推斷
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released FlashProve, an open-source (Apache 2.0) prototype using zkSNARKs so developers can verify a response came from a specific model without revealing weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B MoE, 4-bit), a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/second with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024-token request. It remains a research prototype with no current deployment plans.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 前沿紅隊釋出 FlashProve，這是使用 zkSNARKs 的開源（Apache 2.0）原型，讓開發者能驗證回應來自特定模型而不揭露權重。在 Llama 4 Maverick（400B MoE、4-bit）上，單一 H100 以約 110 tokens/秒產生證明，每 1,024 token 請求的證明約 19 MB。目前仍為研究原型，尚無部署計畫。
anthropic.analysis_en: This advances practical cryptographic verification of model identity, addressing trust issues in routing, evaluation, and potential substitution. It remains a research prototype with substantial overhead relative to inference itself, so production adoption is uncertain.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此舉推進模型身份的實用密碼學驗證，解決路由、評估與潛在替換的信任問題。相對於推斷本身仍有顯著開銷，且為研究原型，生產採用仍不確定。
anthropic.quote: In this post, we share some of that progress, primarily through a system we call FlashProve.
anthropic.quote_zh: 在這篇文章中，我們分享部分進展，主要透過我們稱為 FlashProve 的系統。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 使用 Claude 繪製首個原核生物 vault 粒子 3D 結構
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s biology research team reported the first cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (L05), showing prokaryotic and phage MVP homologs can form vaults. Claude assisted literature search, isolation optimization, and structure mapping; a preprint has been submitted.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 生物學研究團隊報告由噬菌體蛋白（L05）組裝的 vault 樣粒子首個冷凍電鏡結構，顯示原核生物與噬菌體 MVP 同源物可形成 vault。Claude 協助文獻搜尋、分離優化與結構繪製；預印本已提交。
anthropic.analysis_en: This demonstrates AI accelerating a long-standing open problem in cell biology by compressing multi-week structural work into days under human direction, while still requiring expert validation. Broader scientific impact depends on peer review and whether similar workflows scale to other unsolved molecular structures.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此例顯示 AI 在人類指導下將數週結構工作壓縮至數日，加速細胞生物學長期未解問題，但仍需專家驗證。更廣科學影響取決於同儕審查，以及類似工作流程能否擴展至其他未解分子結構。
anthropic.quote: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們分享 Anthropic 生物學研究實驗室的另一項發現：在原核細胞中發現的 vault 粒子首個 3D 結構。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind adds agentic cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 為 Antigravity 加入代理化學資訊技能以加速藥物發現
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched molecular pair analysis, and proposed novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in about an hour.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 為 Google Antigravity 釋出化學資訊技能，結合語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、執行配對分子對分析，並在約一小時內提出帶合成路徑的新型剛性大環化合物。
google.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader utility will depend on accuracy of proposed routes and integration into real laboratory workflows.
google.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委派給專門工具、模型負責規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學循環壓縮至數小時。更廣實用性將取決於所提路徑的準確性，以及與真實實驗室工作流程的整合。
google.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
google.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示配備新化學資訊技能的 Google Antigravity 如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

meta.title_en: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor for parallel agent orchestration
meta.title_zh: Meta 收購 AI 編碼新創 Conductor，強化平行代理編排
meta.summary_en: Meta acquired Conductor, a startup whose platform lets developers run multiple AI coding agents (from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in parallel isolated workspaces. Founder Charlie Holtz confirmed the deal on X and said the team will work with Nat Friedman and Alexandr Wang at Meta Superintelligence Labs; Conductor Cloud will shut down on November 20. Financial terms were not disclosed; Meta confirmed the acquisition to press.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 收購 Conductor，該新創平台讓開發者在平行隔離工作空間中運行多個 AI 編碼代理（來自 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）。創辦人 Charlie Holtz 在 X 確認交易，並表示團隊將與 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的 Nat Friedman 與 Alexandr Wang 合作；Conductor Cloud 將於 11 月 20 日關閉。財務條件未揭露；Meta 向媒體確認收購。
meta.analysis_en: The deal places Meta in the same race as OpenAI to own developer orchestration tools as coding agents proliferate, potentially accelerating its Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs efforts. Impact is uncertain without disclosed terms or details on product integration, and the rapid cloud shutdown creates a short transition for existing users.
meta.analysis_zh: 此交易讓 Meta 與 OpenAI 同場競逐開發者編排工具，隨著編碼代理普及，可能加速其 Muse Code 與 Superintelligence Labs 努力。在未揭露條件或產品整合細節前影響不確定，且雲端服務快速關閉為現有用戶帶來短暫過渡期。
meta.quote: I am very excited to share that Conductor is joining Meta! We have some big, crazy plans for the next interface.
meta.quote_zh: 我非常興奮地分享 Conductor 即將加入 Meta！我們對下一代介面有一些很大、很瘋狂的計畫。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 釋出 1 兆參數 Large 4 開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in European data centers, it supports 1M context and ranks highly among open models on coding agent benchmarks.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 在 Hugging Face 以修改版 MIT 授權釋出 Mistral Large 4（暱稱 Le Chonk）開源權重，這是原生多模態 MoE 模型，總參數約 1 兆、活躍約 490-520 億。在歐洲資料中心以 3,800 顆 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU 訓練，支援 100 萬上下文，並在編碼代理基準中名列開源模型前茅。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference cost and whether the modified license restricts commercial hosting enough to limit distribution.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此舉強化美國封閉實驗室以外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於推斷成本，以及修改授權是否足以限制商業託管而影響分發。

brief_en: OpenAI acquired Pierre for Codex Git tooling, shipped Images 2.6 with GIF support and 50% faster generation, and detailed an autonomous pipeline that patched 948 Linux kernel LPEs. Anthropic open-sourced FlashProve for model-output verification and used Claude to map the first prokaryotic vault structure. Meta acquired Conductor for parallel coding agents. Mistral released open weights for its 1T Large 4 model.
brief_zh: OpenAI 收購 Pierre 強化 Codex Git 工具、推出 Images 2.6（支援 GIF、生成快 50%），並公布自主管線修補 948 個 Linux 內核 LPE。Anthropic 開源 FlashProve 驗證模型輸出，並用 Claude 繪製首個原核生物 vault 結構。Meta 收購 Conductor 以支援平行編碼代理。Mistral 釋出 1 兆參數 Large 4 開源權重。
